text.p: Liquidators have been appointed to wind up the privately-owned retail group Facia Ltd which went into receivership in June, the group's receivers said on Tuesday.
In a statement, KPMG said BDO Stoy Hayward had been appointed to close down Facia. The decision was made at a meeting of the group's creditors earlier on Tuesday in Leeds.

Under KPMG's receivership the bulk of Facia's assets were sold off, including the Sock Shop, Oakland, Contessa and Red or Dead store chains. The receivers said that as a result almost all of the jobs within the group had been saved, and secured creditors would be paid in full.

KPMG spokesman Tony Thompson said: "We had been urging the directors of Facia to seek the appointment of liquidators and now the decision has been taken the process can move forward to ensure a payment is made as soon as possible to the unsecured creditors. That will be the role of the newly appointed liquidators."
Recent press reports have suggested that Stoy Hayward was the preferred choice of the British retail group Sears Plc, which has lodged a claim for 30 mllion stg against Facia.
